title: A registered customer can sign in with valid credentials
Account pages require a signed-in user
Administrative functions are restricted to the admin role
Passwords are stored hashed, never in plain text
Customers can search and sort the product catalog
The catalog is paged without repeating or losing products
Customers can add products to a cart
A customer can place an order and pay by each supported method
A placed order is stored completely and accurately
Address and payment details are validated before an order is accepted
An order cannot be placed for an empty cart
The customer receives an order confirmation email
An admin can manage brands, products, users and view orders
API responses keep their agreed shape
Core customer flows work on a phone-sized screen
